section_summary.extract_value: This section details the method for a single study. Participants included 86 graduate and undergraduate students from Harvard University, with a mean age of 20.68 years. The procedure involved participants completing a questionnaire booklet containing the CAQ, NEO-FFI Openness to Experience Scale, CPS, and Big Five Intellect Adjectives, followed by four timed divergent thinking tests.
